profile.ja: 獣遁の術使いの学生対魔忍。肉体の一部をウサギに獣化させる能力をもつ。優れた聴覚と高い瞬発力で、斥候向きの対魔忍として評価されている。戦闘においては強靭な脚力と対魔殺法を組み合わせた肉弾戦を得意とする。ちなみに噛みつきも高い威力を誇るのだが、本人は使いたがらない。常に人の輪の中心にいるタイプで、友人が多く、朝から晩までエネルギッシュに活動している。その反面、孤独には弱く、長時間の単独任務などには不安が残る。可愛らしい容姿と近い距離感から校内にはファンが多いが、特に誰かと付き合うと言った素振りは見られない。なお、忍法の特性上足の筋力が発達し、特に太腿が太くなっている事を内心気にしている。
profile.en: Mochizuki Una is a student Taimanin who uses Beast-style techniques. She can transform parts of her body into a rabbit, granting her keen hearing and explosive speed, which earns her a reputation as an excellent scout. In combat she favors powerful melee attacks that combine her sturdy legs with anti-demon killing methods. Though her bite packs a hefty punch, she prefers not to use it. She's the type who always stays at the center of a crowd, has many friends, and stays energetic from dawn till dusk. On the flip side, she's vulnerable to loneliness and feels uneasy on long solo missions. Her cute looks and approachable demeanor make her popular around campus, yet she shows no signs of dating anyone. Because of her ninja techniques, her leg muscles—especially her thighs—have become noticeably thick, a fact she's somewhat self-conscious about.

text.ja: 獣遁使いの望月卯奈だよ、よろしくねっ♪　　　なんの獣かって？　それは見てのお楽しみ――えぇっ！？なんでウサギってわかったの！？
text.en: I'm Mochizuki Una, the Beast-style Taimanin - nice to meet you! What kind of beast, you ask? That's for me to know and you to find out - eh?! How did you figure out it's a rabbit?!

text.ja: ぴょん、ぴょん、ぴょーん♪　あ、隊長！　これはね、修行中だよ♪　脚を鍛えるための――え、膝を悪くする？　そうなの！？
text.en: Pyon, pyon, pyon! Oh, Captain! I'm in the middle of training - I'm working on building up my leg strength. Is it bad for my knees? Yeah, it is!

text.ja: うぅ～ん、いい修行方法が思いつかない……お願い、一緒に考えて？　ほら、二人のほうが賑やかで楽しいし……いいの？　ありがとう！
text.en: Ugh, I'm having a hard time coming up with a good training method... Can you help me brainstorm? It's always more fun with two people, and it's more lively... Is that okay? Thanks!

text.ja: ……あ！　隊長、あっちで先生が呼んでるみたい！　どうしてわかるかって、聞こえたからだよ……あれ？　どうして逃げるの、隊長！
text.en: Ah! Captain, it looks like Sensei is calling us over there! How did I know? I heard it, of course! Wait, why are you running away, Captain!

text.ja: 隊長、見～つけた！　この長い耳なら、どこにいたって声が聞こえちゃうからねっ、すぐわかるよ♪
text.en: Captain, found you! With these long ears, I can hear you from anywhere, so it's easy to track you down!

text.ja: うえっ！？　ふ、太くないよ！　鍛えてるけど、ちゃんとマッサージして太くならないようにしてるもん！　太もも、触ってみればわかるよ！
text.en: Ew, no way! My legs may be thick, but I work out and give them massages so they don't get too bulky! You can touch them and see for yourself!

text.ja: 私の獣遁は、兎の力を身体に宿すの。可愛い動物だからって、甘く見ちゃだめだよ？　兎の脚力を人間並みにするんだから……岩だって砕けるよ！
text.en: My Beast-style technique lets me tap into the power of a rabbit. Don't underestimate me just because it's a cute animal - I can crush rocks with my leg strength!

text.ja: うひゃあ！？　あ、やっ……その、耳は……ひんっ！　よ、よく聞こえる分、ちょっと敏感で……あっ、んっ……触っちゃ、だめぇ……ぁんっ……
text.en: Ahh! Oh no, my ears... are a bit sensitive... You can hear really well, but it's also kind of... ah, don't touch them, please!
